## Biography

Peters Base is a station in the Facece system. In July 3312 it served as the registration point for the Colonia tenth-anniversary supply initiative, where pilots were directed to register before supporting the delivery of commodities and rare goods to the Brewer Corporation cargo megaships stationed in the system.
